pokedexEntries.bk: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

pokedexEntries.wh: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

pokedexEntries.sw: They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They’re very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

pokedexEntries.sh: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.
